rulings.item: R1 Aqours package identity for Liella in libc6's place
rulings.recommendation: take glibc's binary names (libc6, libc-bin Essential, libc6-dev Provides libc-dev, libc-dev-bin, locales, libc-l10n) with Source: liella; keep liella6/liella6-dev for coexistence
<abi>+liella<YYYYMMDD>.<n>-<rev>, no epoch; symbols file minimum = the GLIBC_2.x node level, LIELLA_NATIVE via a Liella-only template; shlibs libc6 (>= <abi>)
options laid out: stay 2.39 (patch/verify 5 sources), all 98 (2 libc + 44 libm kernels + 2.41 reference), or mix: sched_[gs]etattr (S) + double sinpi/cospi/tanpi/atanpi (M), rest to the libm backlog

rulings.item: R4 C header provenance: Liella has no header set (liella-gcc uses the host's glibc 2.39 headers)
rulings.recommendation: generate headers from spec/abi tables (OD-1) plus the standards' text; no glibc header text

rulings.item: R5 locale/charmap/translation data for a glibc-free root
rulings.recommendation: ship Devuan's locales and libc-l10n data unchanged (Architecture: all data), compiled by Liella's own localedef

rulings.item: R6 utility programs (ldconfig, getent, getconf, locale, iconv, localedef, ldd, zic) are out of spec scope today
rulings.recommendation: bring them in as a spec utilities part: POSIX, man pages, black-box probes, formats D.1-D.3
owner's call: clean-room SL-TZ (M), or a separate Aqours package built from IANA tzcode that Liella developers never read
drop from Aqours (no Liella nscd client; unscd imports GLIBC_PRIVATE)

informational: libmvec.so.1 (216 exports at GLIBC_2.22/2.35) is shipped by libc6 and absent from spec/abi/versions.tsv; with Liella's own headers declaring no simd variants, rebuilt packages never import it (M-0/M-1 re-scoped in plan section 6)
util-linux (Essential) imports sched_setattr/sched_getattr@GLIBC_2.41: with Liella at 2.39 it blocks a pinned libc6 swap until rebuilt or SCHED-ATTR lands
Scan scripts and data are on the Zen 1 build host under ~/work/LIELLA-SYSTEM-LIBC-PLAN (not committed: they name the LAN mirror)

impact.what: planning and measurement only; no behaviour change
